title: chip-chop mock
description: Replayable backend responses, at <app>/.chipchop/mocks/<id>.mock.json. Generated by an AI from the app's source code (services, interfaces, DTOs) and validated against the inferred responseSchema, so isActive is a boolean and createdAt is a date.

scenario.description: happy, empty, error, edge-long-text, ... free text, but keep names consistent across the app.

generatedFrom.description: Source files and symbols the shapes were inferred from. Lets the AI regenerate when the code changes.

symbol.description: Interface, class, type or function name.

url.description: Path glob without origin. Supports :param and * wildcards, e.g. /api/passwords/:id.

query.description: Query params that must be present. Omit to ignore the query string.

bodyContains.description: Subset of the JSON body that must match. Omit to ignore the body.

json.description: JSON body. Validated against responseSchema when present.

file.description: Path relative to .chipchop/assets/ for binary bodies.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema of the response, inferred from the source types. Not sent to the app; used to validate response.json.
